'''''Plantago holosteum''''' is an [[annual plant]] of the family [[Plantaginaceae]] and the genus ''[[Plantago]]''.<ref>[https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi?lin=s&p=has_linkout&id=1211594 NCBI]</ref>

==Description==
''Plantago holosteum'' grows to {{convert|15|-|40|cm}} in height. The flowering period extends from May to June.<ref name=fa>[http://www.actaplantarum.org/floraitaliae/viewtopic.php?t=50062 Acta Plantarum]</ref>

==Distribution and habitat==
This species is native to [[Southern Europe]] and parts of the [[Middle East]] and [[Northwest Africa]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Plantago subulata L. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:685703-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=20 April 2023 |language=en}}</ref> It prefers dry grasslands, arid and sunny grassy areas on carbonate substrates, at an elevation of {{convert|0|-|1300|m}} above sea level.<ref name=fa/>
